issue.title: E2 completion: a steward that can merge and start a train, contained core pins, and the first steward release
issue.description: The release steward can actually merge a release PR and start release.yml at the fresh tag. Every sealed candidate proves its core tag contains sase's core source pin. One real sase release goes through the steward and is proven against its sealed manifest. The E2 decision record is written.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/e2_steward_train_completion.md requests this work

issue.title: The steward reads a real merge gate from the N1 inventory
issue.description: merge-checks: the steward's expected release-PR checks come from the versioned N1 inventory instead of absent branch protection, and Master Gate is judged on its own jobs rather than on the PR's check list (sase-core plus sase).
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/e2_steward_train_completion.md defines phase merge-checks as one work unit

issue.title: Seal and enforce the core source-pin containment
issue.description: containment: release.yml seals sase-core-revision.txt as the core source pin with a containment proof for tag v<core>, seal and evaluate refuse without it, and the stale rust-backend doc sentence and ratchet test names are fixed.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/e2_steward_train_completion.md defines phase containment as one work unit

issue.title: The steward starts and resumes a train at a fresh tag
issue.description: train-start: a fresh tag with an unsealed draft dispatches release.yml mode=release once instead of reading as WATCHER_BROKEN. A sealed, publishable generation with no PyPI files resumes. A fixture walk drives one train from releasable to released.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/e2_steward_train_completion.md defines phase train-start as one work unit

issue.title: First steward release, acceptance evidence, and the E2 decision record
issue.description: exit: confirm the human cutover, watch the first real release through the steward, prove digests, attestation and containment against the manifest, record acceptance evidence, and write the E2 decision record.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/e2_steward_train_completion.md defines phase exit as one work unit

No sase-core commit; pin unchanged.
